waves.goal: Survive to the end of Wave 4.

pages.wave1_intro: You climb down through the green hatch. The air below is stale and still. What's inside, you wonder?
pages.wave1_intro_ability_rules:
Double Edged (Boss): This boss deals and suffers double damage when its black arrow is targeting a delver.

Fatal Flaw (Boss and Minions): These enemies can only be killed in the order specified next to this ability. Enemies with sequential numbers can be killed at the same time. They can still suffer damage in any order - only the final point of damage remains.
pages.q13_w1_end: Billy the Bear slumps against the scorched wall.
pages.q13_w1_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w1_continue:
You knew the hatch was there, but no one imagined what lay beneath it - a basement that survived the blaze, crawling with creatures that shouldn't be able to exist in open air. The walls are scorched but intact, the air thick and wrong, carrying a faint chemical sting beneath the smoke. These things aren't wild.

You tighten your grip on your weapon and push deeper into the dark. Whatever happened here wasn't an accident - and you're about to find out why.

Delvers gain 2 elements (your choice).
pages.q13_w1_retreat:
You never imagined the Watchtower's basement had survived the blaze, let alone that it was full of monsters. Well, that's enough life endangerment for today.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w2_end: Laura the Flytrap folds in on itself.
pages.q13_w2_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w2_continue:
The flytrap's movements linger in your mind - it didn't thrash or lash out blindly, but struck with precision, almost... trained. Even now, you can't shake the feeling that it was following some unseen command. Creatures of the Tide don't behave like that. You press onward, unease settling deep in your chest.

Delvers heal up to 3 HP.
pages.q13_w2_retreat:
The deeper you look, the less any of this feels natural, and that realization unsettles you more than the creatures themselves. Whatever purpose these creatures serve, they're beyond what you can handle.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w3_end: George the Ape crashes to the floor.
pages.q13_w3_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w3_continue:
That Ape had needles falling out of its flesh when it first came running towards you. Someone's been running experiments, but to what end?

Gain a Level card.

As you reach the lowest floor, you gaze on rows upon rows of creatures immersed in pods filled with yellow liquid, neat handwritten labels beneath each. In the center of the room is the corpse of a human suspended in the air, monster parts forcibly grafted in - the metal connections clearly visible. You retch involuntarily. The corpse opens its eyes and glares at you. It reaches a clawed hand to sever the connections holding it to the ceiling, and scuttles toward you.
pages.q13_w3_retreat:
The deeper you go, the more wrong everything feels - needles, containment, tamed monsters. The goosebumps on your arm tell you the worst is just around the corner, so you turn back, leaving the nightmare beneath the Watchtower undisturbed.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w4_end: The Incomplete Revenant twitches and goes still.
pages.q13_w4_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q13_w4_gone:
Many of the creatures in the submerged pods are beginning to wake up. You flee for your lives and slam the door behind you.

You run back to the town square and collapse, exhausted. When you come to, the first light of a new day is peeking out. You head straight to Master Bram's office and report what you found. He doesn't believe you, but agrees to follow you to the entrance. When you open the door, however, all of the creatures and pods are gone.

Bram laughs. "That was a good prank! I have to hand it to you, you had me a little scared for a moment. I do have to go though, much to do." He leaves.

Your Quest is complete! Add Key Item #20.
pages.q13_w1_paint:
You knew the hatch was there, but no one imagined what lay beneath it - a basement that survived the blaze, crawling with creatures that shouldn't be able to exist in open air. The walls are scorched but intact, the air thick and wrong, carrying a faint chemical sting beneath the smoke. These things aren't wild.

A rusted pipe juts from the scorched wall, spilling black sludge into a drain. The pipe runs up through the ceiling - toward Bird's Nest.

At the hatch frame, flaking green paint catches your eye - the same shade as the chips torn from the festival generator. Whoever attacked the generator came from down here. Behind the frame sits their supply crate, and in it a gauntlet wired with prods that still spark.

You tighten your grip on your weapon and push deeper into the dark. Whatever happened here wasn't an accident - and you're about to find out why.

Add Shop Product #41 Shock Gauntlet to your Purchasable Products. Both delvers gain 2 ELEMENTS of their choice.
